Railway Board Approves Annual Increment Benefit for Retirees

The Railway Board has issued an order granting an additional annual increment benefit to railway employees retiring on June 30. This increment will be added to their pension, leading to an increase in their retirement pay. The decision is being presented as positive news for railway workers.
